QuestInfo.name: Born to Hate
QuestInfo.0: Ask #p2159391# why she has come to Magatia and what #p2154009# is plotting.
QuestInfo.1: Ask #p2159391# why she has come to Magatia and what #p2154009# is plotting.
QuestInfo.2: #p2159391# believes that you are a failure for betraying her 'father' and succumbing to your emotions. She seemed distraught at the fact that #p2154009# would expend so much energy looking for a flawed model like you. She seems to hate emotions, yet she follows them as any other human would. It's quite strange...
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Speak with Beryl in Magatia's #bAlchemy Lab#k

0.0: I am fully repaired! Why can't I beat you?\r\n#L0##bWhy are you here, Beryl? What is #p2154009# scheming?#l\n#k
0.1: You dare utter his name after what you've done?! My father--\r\n#L0##bYou think #p2154009# is your father?#l\n#k
0.2: I know he is.\r\n#L0##bThose are lies, Beryl! He is a monster and a kidnapping thief! He stole us from our homes, he erased our memory. THAT is who #p2154009# is. You are were human once, just like me.#l\n#k
0.3:
My past means nothing. I am #p2159391#, a Xenoroid. I am
#p2154009#'s masterpiece!
#L0##bYou're fooling yourself! Remember who you were!#l
#k
0.4: I'm not a failure like you. My past self was weak and insignificant. The new me will change the world!\r\n#L0##bA failure?#l\n#k
0.5: Shut up and act like a Xenoroid! You've been corrupted by your feelings and memories. You're pathetic! I don't understand why father prizes you so highly.\r\n#L0##bWhat?#l\n#k
0.6: I won't stand for it. You're a failure and a traitor, but father loves you more than me! \r\n#L0##bI-is that why you hate me?#l\n#k
0.7: Shut up!\r\n#L0##bI knew you didn't like me, but #p2300000# insisted I was mistaken. She said you didn't have emotions, but if you really dislike me this much, you MUST still have some feelings!#l\n#k
0.8: I can't stand here and listen to you spewing your soft-hearted nonsense any more! I'm leaving, but this isn't over. Next time we meet, it's the end for you.
